title: Section evaluation on finite pro-etale coproducts
statement: For a finite family of qcqs pro-etale objects whose scheme coproduct is identified with a pro-etale object W by coprojections ι, every sheaf of sets on X.ProEt evaluates on W as the product of its evaluations on the summands, and for an empty family the sections on W form a singleton and W is empty.

source.place: Tag 0F4P, proof of lemma-weakly-contractible-cover; Tag 0DB1, hypotheses (a)-(c)

proof.text: Transport the scheme coproduct open cover along e. Mathlib sigmaOpenCover supplies joint surjectivity and the coprojections are open immersions. Use zariskiPrecoverage_le_propQCPrecoverage to obtain a pro-etale cover of the underlying scheme, map_ofArrows and the definition of ProEt.precoverage to lift it to the small site, and generate_mem_toGrothendieck for its covering sieve. No qcqs hypothesis is required for this covering argument.

Apply Mathlib Presieve.isSheafFor_arrows_iff to this cover. Every tuple is compatible: for the same summand cancel the monic open immersion; for distinct summands cancel e.hom in the commuting square and use isEmpty_of_commSq_sigmaι_of_ne to show the common source is empty. Mathlib Sheaf.isTerminalOfBotCover applied to ProEt.bot_mem_topology, followed by Types.isTerminalEquivUnique, gives Unique sections on an empty ProEt object, so the two restricted sections there agree. Unique amalgamation yields injectivity and surjectivity. If I is empty, joint surjectivity makes W.left empty, and the same empty-cover argument gives Unique sections on W. This is proved in Lean, including the private empty-object helper, with no deferred theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_coproduct_sheaf_core (X : Scheme.{u}) (I : Type v) [Finite I]
    (V : I → X.ProEt) (W : X.ProEt) (ι : ∀ i, V i ⟶ W)
    (e : (∐ fun i ↦ (V i).left) ≅ W.left)
    (hqc : ∀ i, CompactSpace (V i).left)
    (hqs : ∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (V i).left)
    (hι : ∀ i, Sigma.ι (fun i ↦ (V i).left) i ≫ e.hom = (ι i).left) :
    (∀ F : Sheaf (topology X) (Type (max (u + 1) w)),
        Function.Bijective (fun s : F.obj.obj (op W) ↦
          fun i ↦ F.obj.map (ι i).op s)) ∧
      (IsEmpty I → IsEmpty W.left ∧
        ∀ F : Sheaf (topology X) (Type (max (u + 1) w)),
          Nonempty (Unique (F.obj.obj (op W))))
